description: EU Air Traffic: an open platform for live and historical European airspace analytics is a software deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Swadhin Biswas. A self-hosted platform for European air traffic data. A collector polls ADS-B positions, OpenSky flight movements, AirLabs schedules, METAR/TAF and forecast weather, jet-fuel prices and reference data, publishes keyed records to Kafka, and a scheduled pipeline builds Bronze Parquet, incremental Silver tables, a DuckDB star schema and dbt Gold marts. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
